title: SkyrimNet MultiProxy
tagline: Your game, your AI. Mix and match cloud AI and local models for SkyrimNet. Just set it up once, and it’s ready every time you play.
description:
Playing Skyrim with SkyrimNet and tired of fiddling with AI settings? **MultiProxy** is the one place to set it all up, just once. It quietly sits in your system tray and starts up with Skyrim.

**Why you'll want it**
* **Use the AI you already have:** Connect your Claude, ChatGPT, Google, or SuperGrok subscription. You can also use your own keys or run free local models on your graphics card. Pick a different AI for each job, complete with backups.
* **Voices at home:** NPCs speak using voices generated right on your PC. Hear each one before you choose!
* **Borrow a spare PC:** Got a laptop? Its graphics card can help share the heavy lifting.
* **Easy to run:** It installs like a normal app, with a friendly dashboard and built-in help to guide you.

Find the full list of AIs, setup steps, and every setting on GitHub.
author: awesmdiver
changelog:
**A new voice, a guide to hear and pick any voice, and quicker first lines for every character.**

* **Breeze voice:** A natural English voice that mimics a short audio clip. Pick from four sound choices ranging from **Quickest** to **Most natural**. Free for personal use!
* **Which voice?:** A handy new guide on the **Voice** tab. Hear a man and a woman in every voice, then pick your favorite with a single click.
* **Quick first lines:** Characters no longer wait for their voice to be set up.
* **Google Decisions:** Google's decision model joins the quick decisions list.
* **Spare PCs:** While a spare PC starts, the Voice and Decisions tabs keep showing your choice, with "Waiting for it to come online". Press **Update Courier** on your spare PCs to bring them all of this.
* **Fixes:** New Higgs installs are working smoothly again, and outdated graphics drivers now trigger a simple, two-step help message.
